database_audit.method: public search interface, frozen queries, first result page screened
database_audit.notes: The first query returned about 79 broad matches. The only plausible potassium spectroscopy hit was Falke's 2007 thesis/PRA 74, 032503 chapter; inspection showed that its quoted second-order correction is the Doppler correction, not the registered second-order hyperfine target. The second query returned ultracold-gas and Mossbauer material; the third returned no records.

candidate_audit.title: Transition frequencies of the D lines of 39K, 40K, and 41K measured with a femtosecond laser frequency comb
candidate_audit.exclusion: Reports K-40 4P hyperfine constants, including A(P1/2) = -34.523(25) MHz, but does not extract the complete M1-M1 + M1-E2 correction. Its 25 kHz uncertainty cannot identify the registered approximately 8 Hz target. The explicitly applied second-order correction is a Doppler correction.

candidate_audit.title: High-resolution laser spectroscopy on the D1 and D2 lines of 39,40,41K using RF modulated laser light
candidate_audit.exclusion: Reports effective K-40 4P hyperfine constants, including A(P1/2) = -34.49(11) MHz, but no complete second-order correction. The uncertainty is about 110 kHz.

candidate_audit.title: High precision spectroscopy on beams of atoms and dimers
candidate_audit.exclusion: The potassium chapter reproduces the PRA 74, 032503 analysis. Full-text inspection shows that 'second order' refers to a -2.2(5) kHz Doppler correction; no complete second-order hyperfine correction is extracted.

candidate_audit.title: The Hyperfine Structure of Potassium-40
candidate_audit.exclusion: Pedagogical compilation of first-order hyperfine constants and Zeeman structure; it reports no independent complete second-order correction.

candidate_audit.title: Hyperfine effects on potassium tune-out wavelengths and polarizabilities
candidate_audit.exclusion: Calculates tune-out wavelengths and hyperfine Stark shifts, not the registered complete delta A(P1/2) second-order correction.

candidate_audit.title: Revisiting Nuclear Quadrupole Moments in 39-41K Isotopes
candidate_audit.exclusion: Calculates B/Q and hyperfine constants to infer nuclear quadrupole moments; it does not provide the complete M1-M1 + M1-E2 delta A(P1/2) target.

candidate_audit.title: Survey of hyperfine structure measurements in alkali atoms
candidate_audit.exclusion: Review and compilation of measured hyperfine constants; no independent K-40 complete second-order correction is reported.

candidate_audit.title: Second-order effects on the hyperfine structure of P states of alkali-metal atoms
candidate_audit.exclusion: This is the registered construction source for the shared potassium electronic T1/T2 inputs, and its tabulated isotope set omits K-40. It has construction overlap and cannot be an independent benchmark.
